title: 0130 at a glance: the framework as packages, one tag each

cards.title: 31 packages
cards.text: The projects a product builds on are NuGet packages on GitHub Packages, moving to nuget.org at 1.0.

cards.title: A version from a tag
cards.text: MinVer reads LouisAgent.Core-0.2.0; an untagged neighbour keeps its last version.

cards.title: One commit, one batch
cards.text: A release is a tag on main; every package tagged on the commit is published together.

cards.title: Nothing unrestorable
cards.text: A package whose framework dependency is neither in the batch nor on the feed is refused.
